quote: Typical plants in the US process at least 100,000 bushels per day (bu/day, or 2,500 tonne/day) and operate continuously for nearly 365 days per year.
justification: Genuinely continuous (365 days/year, 2500 t/day) and genuinely empirical (stochastic frontier analysis building an ENERGY STAR EnPI tool) — but wet corn milling is food and agricultural processing and is NOT one of the eight §5.3 registered sectors. The 'refining' match was the word, not petroleum refining. Reclassified as the 13th exploratory case under §5.3's unlisted-sector rule; not a Corpus-B membership decision.
